'''Wil Asani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived through the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and into the dark times.

==Biography==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Asani became a resistance fighter and member of [[The Eleven]], a group started by former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Roan Lands]], after [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] reorganized the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] into his [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. After Lands and [[Dona Telamark]] were arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], Asani and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Amie Antin]] met with [[Oryon]] and [[Trever Flume]] where they would send in information to rescue Lands and Telemark. However, they were interrupted by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and Asani was forced to put the data on his computer. After fleeing through a tunnel, Asani and Antin took Flume, [[Fy-Tor-Ana|Solace]] and [[Oryon]] to a landing platform in order to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

When Flume returned to [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] with Solace and Oryon, Asani and Antin helpeded to find where Telemark and Lands were being held for trial. Unable to locate the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the only information he could give them was that the trial was on the ''[[True Justice]]'', a ship that traveled constantly picking up political prisoners. After leaving the planet, Asani traveled with the other opposition leaders to the [[Jedi asteroid]] where they would remain hidden from the Empire. As the [[Transpirator/Legends|transpirator]] the ship broke and they had to stop over, Asani and Ferus discovered a tracking device on board. While he remained on the base, it was revealed that [[Toma (resistance leader)|Toma]] was serving as [[Spy/Legends|spy]] to the Empire and was the one who activated the tracking device which allowed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the Empire to find the resistance leaders. Asani perished in the Jedi asteroid's destruction.<ref name="LOTJR" />
